Key observations: white fluffy cottony growth on stems, large black sclerotia (hard black bodies) embedded in the white mold, bleached stem lesions at the base. This strongly points to **White Mold**.

This is a textbook White Mold case. Diaporthe shows only parallel rows of small black pycnidia with no white cottony growth.
